summary: Vitest covers the MENU form, button add/remove, target picker options (steps + End), and all validation branches (empty label, no-callback, non-http url), plus End->null encoding, id/next preservation, edit pre-fill, and inline funnel_broken_edge mapping. One Playwright happy-path added with the graceful-skip pattern. Test pyramid is balanced; assertions are behavioral, not implementation-coupled.

findings.finding: All TDD anchors from task 6 are covered: renders MENU in picker, add/remove rows, picker lists steps+End, blocks empty label, blocks no-callback menu, blocks non-http url, maps funnel_broken_edge 422 inline. Extra coverage: End->null + id preservation, and edit pre-fill of existing buttons.

funnels_menuGoldenPath_buildAndActivate builds a MENU with 2 callback buttons (one -> step via SearchableSelect, one -> End), saves and activates. Reuses login/openDraftEditor/addSendMessage helpers and the test.skip(!backendUp/!seedReady) guard so it never fails the suite without a backend (verified: 3 skipped).
Full vitest suite (387 tests) green after changes; no Phase-1 regressions.
